name: termweave-sdk-v2
description: A clean, single-package Termweave SDK and application template.

scripts.dev: bun run prepare && bun run sidecar:build && tauri dev --config src-tauri/.generated/override.json
scripts.build: bun run check && bun run prepare && bun run sidecar:build && tauri build --config src-tauri/.generated/override.json
scripts.lint: eslint app src scripts shared tests vite.config.ts
scripts.rust:check: bun run sidecar:build && cargo check --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.check: bun run test && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run rust:check
